static.下载模型，选择配置，让本地算力开始工作。: Download a model, choose a profile, and put your hardware to work.
static.你的模型，你的算力。把本地模型变成随时可用的服务。: Your models. Your hardware. Turn local models into ready-to-use services.
static.查看 GPU、内存与可用算力: Explore your GPUs and available memory
static.选择一个喜欢的模型，下载后即可创建启动项目。支持断点续传。: Find a model, download it, and create a launch item. Interrupted downloads can resume.
static.从加载到就绪，实时了解模型服务的运行状态。: Follow your model from loading to ready, with live service output.
static.了解这台机器的 GPU、内存与存储，为模型选择合适的配置。: Explore this machine’s GPUs, memory, and storage to find the right model configuration.
static.网络控制 · 随机令牌保护: Network control · protected by a random token
static.选择启动项目后即可启动服务: Choose a launch item to start a service
static.管理已保存的模型服务与聊天 WebUI。: Manage saved model services and chat WebUIs.
static.每个项目可直接启动、编辑或删除。: Start, edit, or delete each item directly.
static.的字段为必填项，保存配置不会启动模型。: are required. Saving a profile does not launch the model.
static.模型、服务地址与运行设备: Model, service address, and compute device
static.留空时使用目录名: Uses the directory name when empty
static.支持 Hugging Face 模型目录、FastLLM 模型文件和 GGUF。: Supports Hugging Face model directories, FastLLM model files, and GGUF.
static.浏览当前机器上的文件夹，选中后会填入模型路径。: Browse folders on this machine and insert the selected model path.
static.请确认是否继续。: Confirm whether you want to continue.
static.根据模型结构、权重规模和本机硬件推荐设备与混合推理参数。: Recommend devices and hybrid-inference settings from the model structure, weight size, and local hardware.
static.支持内置 MTP 以及外置 MTP、DFlash2、DSpark: Supports built-in MTP and external MTP, DFlash2, or DSpark
static.留空使用模型内置能力: Leave empty to use built-in model capabilities
static.为 MoE 专家层和大型 N-gram 表选择独立存储设备: Choose separate storage devices for MoE experts and large N-gram tables
static.将全部或尾部 MoE 专家层放到独立设备；关闭时由 FastLLM 跟随主设备。: Place all or trailing MoE expert layers on a separate device; when off, FastLLM follows the primary device.
static.按权重比例混合使用多个设备，适合显存、内存与 SSD 联合推理。: Mix devices by weight, combining GPU memory, system memory, and SSD storage.
static.-1 表示全部 MoE 层；正整数表示最后 N 层。: -1 selects every MoE layer; a positive integer selects the trailing N layers.
static.大型 PLE 表可放到高速 SSD，以降低主机内存占用。: Large PLE tables can use a fast SSD to reduce host-memory usage.
static.缓存、采样、MoE 与额外参数: Cache, sampling, MoE, and extra arguments
static.沿用配置；可填 yarn 或 JSON: Use model config; yarn or JSON
static.留空使用默认缓存: Leave empty to use the default cache
static.保存在当前用户的本地配置文件中。: Stored in the current user's local configuration file.
static.把指定数量的尾部 MoE 层放到 NUMA CPU 或磁盘。: Place the specified number of trailing MoE layers on NUMA CPU or disk.
static.敏感值会隐藏，参数不经过 Shell: Sensitive values are hidden; arguments do not pass through a shell
static.把模型下载到本机: Download a model to this machine
static.支持断点续传和并行下载。下载任务由独立进程托管，退出 Launcher 时会一并: Supports resumable and parallel downloads. The task runs in a managed process and stops when Launcher exits.
static.从常用模型中选择，或直接填写任意 ModelScope 模型 ID。: Choose a common model or enter any ModelScope model ID.
static.目录已存在时会校验缓存并继续未完成的下载。: An existing directory is checked and any incomplete download is resumed.
static.Token 只保存在当前页面内存中，通过环境变量传给下载进程，不写入命令或配置文: The token stays in this page's memory and is passed through the environment. It is not written to commands or configuration files.
static.参数不经过 Shell，Token 不显示: Arguments do not pass through a shell; token is hidden
static.模型文件可能占用较多磁盘空间，请先确认保存位置。: Model files may use substantial disk space. Confirm the destination first.
static.实时查看 Launcher 与模型服务输出，启动进度事件会自动整理为可读状态。: View live Launcher and model-service output. Startup events are summarized into readable status updates.
static.启动模型后，日志会显示在这里。: Logs will appear here after the model starts.
static.快速查看 CPU、内存、GPU、NUMA 和模型所在磁盘；数据直接来自当前机器。: Inspect CPU, memory, GPU, NUMA, and model storage using data from this machine.
static.切换到此页面后自动检测。: Detection starts automatically when this page opens.
static.管理本地模型、下载与运行环境。: Manage local models, downloads, and hardware.
static.启动 API Server 后即可使用工作室。: Start an API Server to use Studio.

messages.Try another name or model path, or clear: Try another name or model path, or clear the filters.
messages.Choose a local model and save a profile: Choose a local model and save a profile to launch an API or chat service.
messages.Discard unsaved changes and return to th: Discard unsaved changes and return to the launch item list?
messages.This removes only the saved launch confi: This removes only the saved launch configuration. Model files remain on disk.
messages.Exit Launcher? Running model services an: Exit Launcher? Running model services and downloads will also stop.

messages.Only the first {count} folders are shown: Only the first {count} folders are shown.
messages.Model path is required for automatic con: A model path is required for automatic configuration.
messages.Model path does not exist; choose a loca: The model path does not exist; choose a local model first.
messages.GGUF模型路径必须是已存在的本地 .gguf 文件。: The GGUF model path must point to an existing local .gguf file.
messages.模型路径必须是已存在的本地模型目录，或 .gguf 文件。: The model path must point to an existing local model directory or .gguf file.
messages.模型配置文件夹必须是已存在的本地目录。: The model configuration directory must be an existing local directory.
messages.WebUI最大输出Token必须是正整数。: The maximum WebUI output token count must be a positive integer.
messages.WebUI思考模式必须是 true 或 false。: WebUI thinking mode must be true or false.
messages.预处理分片大小必须是正整数或 auto。: Chunked prefill size must be a positive integer or auto.
messages.最大Batch必须是正整数或 auto。: Maximum batch must be a positive integer or auto.
messages.单会话上下文必须是正整数或 auto。: Per-session context must be a positive integer or auto.
messages.tokens数量必须是正整数或 auto。: Total tokens must be a positive integer or auto.
messages.线程数必须是正整数或 auto。: Thread count must be a positive integer or auto.
messages.Draft Token数必须是正整数或 auto。: Draft token count must be a positive integer or auto.
messages.MTP 必须是 0-8 的整数或 auto。: MTP must be an integer from 0 to 8 or auto.
messages.推测算法必须是 auto、mtp、dflash 或 dspark。: The speculative algorithm must be auto, mtp, dflash, or dspark.
messages.Draft模型路径必须是已存在的本地目录或文件。: The draft model path must point to an existing local directory or file.
messages.DFlash2 必须指定 Draft模型路径。: DFlash2 requires a draft model path.
messages.DFlash2 的 Draft模型路径必须是目录。: The DFlash2 draft model path must be a directory.
messages.DFlash2 和 MTP 不能同时启用。: DFlash2 and MTP cannot be enabled together.
messages.内置 MTP 必须指定 1-8 的 MTP token 数。: Built-in MTP requires an MTP token count from 1 to 8.
messages.MTP Token 数和 Draft Token 数必须一致。: MTP token count and draft token count must match.
messages.DSpark 的 Draft模型路径必须是目录。: The DSpark draft model path must be a directory.
messages.内置 DSpark 必须指定 Draft Token 数。: Built-in DSpark requires a draft token count.
messages.DSpark 和 MTP 不能同时启用。: DSpark and MTP cannot be enabled together.
messages.显存利用率必须是 0 到 1 之间的数字，例如 0.9。: GPU memory ratio must be a number from 0 to 1, such as 0.9.
messages.CUDA卡号必须是非负整数；留空表示 0。: CUDA device ID must be a non-negative integer; leave it empty for 0.
messages.串行参数格式不对。请输入正整数卡数，例如 4；或输入至少两个卡号，例如 0,1,: Invalid pipeline device format. Enter a positive GPU count such as 4, or at least two IDs such as 0,1,2.
messages.TP卡数/ID格式不对。请输入卡数，例如 1 或 4；或输入卡号，例如 0、cu: Invalid TP device format. Enter a count such as 1 or 4, or IDs such as 0, cuda:1, or 0,2,3.
messages.选择自定义主设备时必须填写自定义主设备。: A custom primary device value is required when custom is selected.
messages.MOE推理设备只能选择 NUMA CPU 或 Disk。: The MoE device must be NUMA CPU or Disk.
messages.MOE推理设备配置无效。: The MoE inference device configuration is invalid.
messages.选择自定义MOE设备时必须填写设备映射。: A device map is required when a custom MoE device is selected.
messages.自定义MOE设备映射格式无效，请填写设备列表或正权重映射。: The custom MoE device map is invalid; enter a device list or a map with positive weights.
messages.MOE设备层数格式不对。请输入正整数，例如 8；或输入 -1 表示全部 MOE: Invalid MoE device layer count. Enter a positive integer such as 8, or -1 for all MoE layers.
messages.N-gram存储设备只能选择 CPU、Disk 或 auto。: The N-gram storage device must be CPU, Disk, or auto.
messages.选择自定义权重类型时必须填写自定义权重类型。: A custom weight type is required when custom is selected.
messages.选择自定义MOE类型时必须填写自定义MOE类型。: A custom MoE type is required when custom is selected.
messages.temperature 必须是大于等于 0 的数字，或留空使用模型默认值。: temperature must be a number greater than or equal to 0, or empty for the model default.
messages.top_p 必须是 0 到 1 之间的数字，或留空使用模型默认值。: top_p must be a number from 0 to 1, or empty for the model default.
messages.top_k 必须是正整数，或留空使用模型默认值。: top_k must be a positive integer, or empty for the model default.
messages.repeat_penalty 必须是大于等于 0 的数字，或留空使用模型默认值。: repeat_penalty must be a number greater than or equal to 0, or empty for the model default.
